import json, re, random, time, chess, sys
rules = [(re.compile(p), r) for p, r in json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))]
def run(fen):
    for p, r in rules: fen = p.sub(r, fen)
    return fen.split("\n")
def ref(fen):
    b = chess.Board(fen); s=set()
    for m in b.legal_moves:
        if m.promotion and m.promotion != chess.QUEEN: continue
        c=b.copy(); c.push(m); s.add(" ".join(c.fen().split(" ")[:-2]))
    return s
def check(fen):
    ours=[" ".join(x.split(" ")[:-2]) for x in run(fen)]
    exp=ref(fen)
    ok = len(ours)==len(exp) and all(x in exp or x.rpartition(" ")[0]+" -" in exp for x in ours)
    if not ok:
        print("FAIL", fen); print(sorted(ours)); print(sorted(exp)); return False
    return True
ex="rnb1k1nr/p2p1ppp/3B4/1p1NPN1P/6P1/3P1Q2/P1P5/q4Kb1 w kq - 0 1"
print(run(ex))
random.seed(int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else 0)
n=0; t=time.time(); bad=0
for g in range(300):
    b=chess.Board()
    while not b.is_game_over() and b.ply()<200:
        if b.turn==chess.WHITE and b.legal_moves.count()>0:
            n+=1
            if not check(b.fen()): bad+=1
            if bad>3: sys.exit()
        ms=list(b.legal_moves)
        # bias toward captures/castling/ep/promo
        pri=[m for m in ms if b.is_castling(m) or b.is_en_passant(m) or m.promotion]
        b.push(random.choice(pri) if pri and random.random()<0.7 else random.choice(ms))
print(n,"positions", bad, "bad", (time.time()-t)/n, "s/pos")
EOF
